source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 12 to 16
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 9, 2026 · 14 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Castlevania: Belmont's Curse KONAMI ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $29.99 Pre-order Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse – October 15 XBOX Play Anywhere 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle. Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation? Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Activision Publishing Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $69.99 Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (Campaign Early Access) XBOX Play Anywhere Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point. Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 today to gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 ahead of its global launch on October 23. Deep Dish Dungeon Raw Fury AB ☆☆☆☆☆ 131 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Deep Dish Dungeon – October 13Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Deep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness. In an atmospheric environment, explore corridors, rooms and passageways solo or with up to two friends, and gather resources to improve your camping site. Craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows. Planet Zoo 2 Frontier Developments ☆☆☆☆☆ 27 ★★★★★ Get it now Planet Zoo 2 – October 13XBOX Play Anywhere Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2 – the sequel to the beloved zoo simulation game. Let your creativity soar by constructing and managing distinctive zoos around the world, full of awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species for the first time. Plus, take the next step in animal conservation and release your species into customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves. Valor Mortis Lyrical Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 340 ★★★★★ $39.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Valor Mortis – October 13Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere You served Napoleon. You died for Napoleon. You have risen for Napoleon. You are William, a soldier of the Grande Armée brought back from a battlefield grave. But the Europe you awaken to is not the one you sacrificed for. A mysterious plague now sweeps the continent, and you have been reborn with its corrupting power pulsing through your veins. Each death is a chance to grow stronger. Master a combat system of parries, dashes, and visceral finishers across a variety of weapons. Channel your power to enhance attacks and unlock new supernatural abilities to inflict upon your enemies. Just Dance: Decades of Hits Ubisoft ☆☆☆☆☆ 168 ★★★★★ $39.99 Get it now Just Dance: Decades of Hits – October 13 Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography. Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades. Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea Natsume Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $49.99 Get it now Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea – October 14 Embark on an unforgettable journey through the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure! Raised in the quiet comfort of Bloomfield Village, your life is about to change forever. A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land. Venture across a vast, living landscape filled with hidden caves, remote islands, lively towns, and long-forgotten secrets. Between your travels, cultivate your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a place to call home. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you’ll meet along the way, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 Devolver Digital, Big Fan Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $24.99 Get it now Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 – October 14 Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter. Bluey's Happy Snaps Gameloft ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ Get it now Bluey’s Happy Snaps – October 15Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Play, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for Real Life. Bluey and Bingo have found Dad’s old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around Bluey’s hometown of Brisbane as you snap photos of the games you play, chase bin chickens and uncover hidden surprises. Each snapshot is saved to your own scrapbook, where you can keep your best moments. Chained Beasts Featherweight Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Chained Beasts – October 15Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Step into the Colosseum chained to your friends. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionRecovering from uncertain times, your Peeps find themselves on the back of Kewa - a lonely Space Whale journeying across the universe. Building a city on the back of a sentient creature comes with its own set of challenges, but as you build your relationship and travel across the galaxy, you'll come across great opportunities for exploration and stable expansion. Meet other species, pursue the needs and wants of your Peeps, and seek the truth about their ancestors and the Space Whales alike. THE WHALE & THE CITY The vastness of space is full of mysteries, and as you first arrive at your new home atop the Space Whale Kewa, your Peeps will quickly learn the need to work together – with each other, but also with their new home. • A Home Among the Stars - Build a sprawling city on the back of a universe-traveling Space Whale as your Peeps seek places to live and work. Your new home is largely desolate and inhospitable when you arrive, save for a small patch of green by the water – work around the contours of the land as you plan your city, taking into account the efficiency of your production chains. Will you simply place buildings as the land allows, or will you change its very shape to take advantage of adjacency bonuses and reduced travel times? • Reach Far and Wide - Terraform the land around you to better suit your needs. Create a thriving ecosystem by digging canals and adding top soil in preparation for farming. Plant trees to maintain a steady flow of raw materials, and maintain entire forests to help spread the atmosphere and facilitate the expansion of your city. • A Fragile Equilibrium - Prepare to seek out additional resources as you research new technologies and gain access to advanced goods. Your people’s needs will grow, and complex logistics networks and mining infrastructure will follow. You must be careful not to tip the delicate balance of the ecosystem, however – the land on Kewa is fragile, and if not tended to with care, your habitat will shrink. Will you walk a fine line of sustainability by risking Kewa’s ecosystem, or will you seek opportunities to instead gather resources on other worlds to keep Kewa happy? JOURNEY ACROSS THE UNIVERSE Unveil the shared history of the galaxy as you travel from system to system with Kewa – seek answers about your past, learn about the history of the Space Whales, and understand the unique relationships that bind everyone together. • Reliable Outposts - Kewa’s environment is plentiful, but not without limits – there will often be a dearth of essential resources and space, and you’ll want to ensure the environment is not over-exploited. Create outposts on nearby planets and seek out supplementary sources of what you need – but unless you build a strong relationship with Kewa, you may find it difficult to predict how long you have at an outpost before Kewa decides it's time to leave a system behind. • A Travel Companion - Kewa longs for connection, and is no mere pet – your home has hopes and dreams for the journey through space. Through understanding Kewa’s needs and desires you can better build a symbiotic relationship. This will give you the opportunity to work in collaboration and allow you to decide on a path together as you journey across the universe. • Friends Along the Way - On your journey, you will cross paths with alien species offering unique opportunities – additional objectives and their subsequent rewards, opportunities for trade, and new technologies with the doors they open. Balance your people’s survival, prosperity, and progress with the need to co-exist with Kewa in a journey across space. Beyond These Stars asks you to consider the logistics of your supply chains and production lines within the context of a living, breathing, sentient world.Show morePublished byHooded HorseDeveloped byBalancing Monkey GamesPlay withPCCapabil
